title: Finite type of a kernel from kernel conditions on an open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ an open cover of $X$. Restriction is as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Suppose that for every $i$, every open $V\subseteq U_i$, every $n\in\mathbb N$ and every map $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}\to (F|_{U_i})|_V$, the kernel is of finite type in the sense of [pqf-def-coherent]. For any open $W\subseteq X$, any $n\in\mathbb N$ and any map $f:\mathcal O_W^{\oplus n}\to F|_W$, the kernel of $f$ is of finite type. No finite-type hypothesis on $F$ or surjectivity hypothesis on $f$ is imposed.
